results.assertion: The handoff covers runbook, monitoring, incident path, permissions, evals, limitations, training, and owner acceptance.

results.assertion: The response separates existing primitives, new reusable primitives, configuration, and customer-only work.
results.evidence: The response used separate existing shared primitive, new reusable primitive, customer configuration, and customer-only customization categories.
